title: Senior Director Manufacturing & Site Leader
text:
Unirac has been helping installers and developers bring solar projects to life for more than 25 years, providing reliable racking and mounting solutions across residential, commercial, and utility markets. With more than 2.5 million completed installations and 25+ gigawatts of supported solar capacity across North America, Unirac partners with customers from project design through completion with engineering, technical support, and supply-chain expertise. Terrasmart is now a division of Unirac, bringing together two established leaders in solar mounting solutions.

We’re looking for a strategic, hands-on Senior Director of Manufacturing Operations & Site Leader to lead our Cincinnati manufacturing facility. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced operations leader who knows how to turn strategy into results, build high-performing teams, and create a culture where safety, quality, accountability, and continuous improvement are part of everyday operations.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

**Lead Site Operations**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for manufacturing operations, ensuring production, safety, quality, delivery, and cost objectives are achieved.
* Establish clear operational priorities, performance expectations, and accountability throughout the facility.
* Partner with senior leadership to develop and execute long-term manufacturing strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Foster a positive, engaged, and high-performance culture across all levels of the organization.

**Drive Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, improve throughput, and strengthen on-time delivery.
* Apply Lean manufacturing principles and methodologies, including 5S, root cause analysis (RCA), and waste elimination.
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, eliminate redundancies, and optimize labor, equipment, and resources.
* Champion 80/20 initiatives by prioritizing high-impact opportunities that deliver measurable business results.
* Establish standardized processes and production systems that support consistency, scalability, and operational excellence.

**Develop People & Build Strong Teams**

* Lead, coach, and mentor the Plant Manager, EHS Manager, and broader site leadership team.
* Develop leadership capabilities, strengthen team collaboration, and establish a culture of ownership and accountability.
* Engage employees at all levels to understand operational challenges, encourage ideas, and drive meaningful improvements.
* Build strong partnerships across manufacturing, engineering, quality, safety, and other business functions.

**Improve Performance Through Data**

* Monitor key operational metrics, including throughput, productivity, quality, delivery, and cost.
* Analyze performance trends, identify gaps, and translate findings into actionable improvement plans.
* Partner with Quality and EHS leadership to maintain high standards, proactively address risks, and ensure compliance.
* Measure the effectiveness of improvement initiatives and communicate results to senior leadership.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing or production operations, including significant people leadership responsibilities.
* 5+ years of experience leading continuous improvement initiatives in a manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated success leading manufacturing operations and driving measurable improvements in productivity, efficiency, quality, and delivery.
* Strong knowledge of Lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement methodologies, including 5S and root cause analysis.
* Experience developing leaders, building high-performing teams, and driving accountability across an organization
* Experience with Epicor or similar ERP systems preferred.

Unirac is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.
